I flagged two things for you as issues (not defects in this diff): the actual reconciliation work (gap_queue v2-23, MASTER_GAP_AUDIT) still hasn't been done, and the broader 20-invocation self-dispatching chain needs your explicit sign-off before any future phase attempts a real push/email/self-dispatch — that shouldn't ride on tier1 autonomous trust just because each individual PROGRESS.md-only diff looks harmless.
